name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: A native-checkbox primitive for product forms and settings surfaces. It includes classic, soft, dot, and toggle visual variants, label and description copy, error state, disabled state, indeterminate state, checkbox groups, and card-style checkbox rows.
author: Wensity <hello@wensity.com>

theme.font-sans: var(--font-satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif)

docs: Free Wensity component. Installs to @components/wensity/checkbox.tsx. For Pro components and updates, use pnpm dlx wensity@latest add checkbox.
